Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Amber slit-pupil eyes; fox ears with white tips — never rounded, never human ears.
  • Red camellia kanzashi with a beaded drop; red silk threads trail through the fingers.
  • Cream through oxblood — the warm ramp separates her from Shizuka's plum-rose.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
